text: On-call handoff: <@U07DEVON> you're primary this week, I'm secondary. Quiet weekend except one PagerDuty blip on the Console API at 03:12, self-resolved.
Got it. I'll look at that blip, probably the connection pool again.
Dumb question: where do invoices actually get generated? I'm adding a 'download invoice' link in the Console and can't find the endpoint.
Not dumb. Billing service owns that. <@U06MEI> is the person, she wrote the runbook.

Invoices are rendered by the billing service nightly job (`invoice-render`, 02:00 UTC) and stored as PDFs. Use `GET /v1/billing/invoices/:id/pdf`, it returns a signed link valid for 15 min. Don't hit the billing DB directly from the Console. See https://wiki.northwind.dev/eng/runbook-billing-service
